$comment: URL templates for build_link.py, one per provider. Source: docs/research/integrations.md section 1 (each template was opened in a browser on checked_on and the prefilled fields were read back). Every host must stay inside backend/app/links.py PROVIDERS[allowlist] (test_build_link.py checks it). Placeholders: {name} is filled by build_link.py and percent-encoded (characters in 'safe' / 'key_safe' stay as they are); a value that is exactly {name[]} repeats the key once per list item, with {i} in the key replaced by the item's index; a pair is left out when one of its placeholders has no value. 'params' are the only command-line parameters build_link.py accepts for the provider.

booking.label: Booking.com

destination.help: Where to search, free text; Italian names work. Most specific first, e.g. 'Alfama, Lisbona'.

child-ages.help: Ages of the children (0-17), comma-separated, e.g. 8,5. Omit when there are none.

rooms.help: Number of rooms (default 1); at most one room per adult.

booking.travellers: Every child is sent with its age (one 'age' parameter per child, age at check-out).

airbnb.label: Airbnb

destination.help: City plus province or country, comma-separated, e.g. 'Lisbona, Portogallo' or 'Reggio Emilia, RE'. A bare city name can resolve to the wrong place.

child-ages.help: Ages of the children (0-17), comma-separated, e.g. 8,1. Omit when there are none.

airbnb.travellers: Airbnb takes no ages: 13-17 are counted as adults, 2-12 as children, under 2 as infants (infants are not guests).

google_flights.label: Google Voli
unverified: the wording for infants in q (infants are searched as children)

from.help: Departure airport or metropolitan IATA code, upper case, e.g. MXP or MIL.

to.help: Arrival airport or metropolitan IATA code, upper case, e.g. LIS.

return.help: Return date, YYYY-MM-DD; omit for one way.

child-ages.help: Ages of the children (0-17), comma-separated. Omit when there are none.

google_flights.travellers: Ages cannot be sent: 12-17 are counted as adults, 0-11 as children with a seat. At most one child under 2 per adult.

expedia_hotels.label: Expedia

destination.help: Where to search, free text, e.g. 'Lisbona, Portogallo'.

adults.help: Number of adults (18 and over), all rooms together.

child-ages.help: Ages of the children (0-17), comma-separated. Omit when there are none.

rooms.help: Number of rooms (default 1); at most one room per adult.

expedia_hotels.travellers: Adults are spread over the rooms as evenly as possible (every room gets an adult); children go to the rooms in turn, each sent as room_age.

expedia_flights.label: Expedia

from.help: Departure airport or metropolitan IATA code, upper case, e.g. MXP.

to.help: Arrival airport or metropolitan IATA code, upper case, e.g. LIS.

return.help: Return date, YYYY-MM-DD; omit for one way.

child-ages.help: Ages of the children (0-17), comma-separated. Omit when there are none.

expedia_flights.travellers: Every child 0-17 is sent with its age; children under 2 get their own seat (infantinlap:N). At most one child under 2 per adult.

kiwi.label: Kiwi.com

from.help: Departure city and country in ENGLISH, comma-separated, e.g. 'Milan, Italy' (becomes milan-italy).

to.help: Arrival city and country in ENGLISH, e.g. 'Lisbon, Portugal'.

return.help: Return date, YYYY-MM-DD; omit for one way.

child-ages.help: Ages of the children (0-17), comma-separated. Omit when there are none.

kiwi.travellers: Kiwi takes no ages: 12-17 are counted as adults, 2-11 as children, under 2 as infants. At most one infant per adult.
kiwi.warning: A slug Kiwi does not know makes it silently restore the user's previous search: prefer the Kiwi MCP and use this link only as a fallback, with English city names.

lastminute.label: lastminute.com

from.help: Departure airport or metropolitan IATA code, upper case, e.g. MIL.

to.help: Arrival airport or metropolitan IATA code, upper case, e.g. LIS.

return.help: Return date, YYYY-MM-DD; omit for one way (unverified).

child-ages.help: Ages of the children (0-17), comma-separated. Omit when there are none.

lastminute.travellers: 12-17 are counted as adults; children under 12 are sent with their ages. At most one child under 2 per adult.
lastminute.warning: Only a fallback when the lastminute MCP fails: this host shows prices in GBP, one way and child ages are unverified.

trenitalia.label: Trenitalia
unverified: the return date on the second step of a round trip

from.help: Official departure station name, e.g. 'Milano Centrale', 'Firenze S. M. Novella'.

to.help: Official arrival station name, e.g. 'Roma Termini'.

time.help: Earliest outbound departure, HH:MM (only the hour is used; default 08:00).

return.help: Return date, YYYY-MM-DD; omit for one way.

return-time.help: Earliest return departure, HH:MM (only with return; default 08:00).

child-ages.help: Ages of the children (0-17), comma-separated. Omit when there are none.

trenitalia.travellers: 15-17 are counted as adults, 0-14 as 'ragazzi' (noOfChildren). Under 4 travel free without a seat on national trains, but the link asks for a seat for every child.

italo.label: Italo

from.help: Departure station: an Italo code or its name from the station table, e.g. MC_ or 'Milano Centrale'.

to.help: Arrival station: an Italo code or its name from the station table, e.g. RMT or 'Roma Termini'.

return.help: Return date, YYYY-MM-DD; omit for one way.

child-ages.help: Ages of the children (0-17), comma-separated. Omit when there are none.

italo.travellers: Adults are sent as standard adults (their ages are not known); children 14-17 as Giovani (yng), 3-13 as Bambini (chd), 0-2 as infants (inf).

omio.label: Omio
unverified: route pages for routes Omio does not list (they show a 404 page)

from.help: Departure city, Italian name, e.g. 'Firenze' (becomes firenze).

omio.travellers: Omio cannot prefill passengers or a return date: the link opens the search form with one passenger.
omio.note_it: Su Omio scegli il numero di passeggeri prima di cercare. Se la pagina non esiste, cerca la tratta da omio.it.
